notes.title: FIND ALL 5:Vikings Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228140/23aba58a223a486deb8974749b6f90fd52795d48.png[/img]
Boom! Axes banging. They're here! Watch out for Vikings in the new game “Find All 5”! New game solutions and animated pictures are waiting for you. Follow the north winds!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155430/FIND_ALL_5_Vikings/

notes.title: New update: Helper hamster!
notes.notes:
A helper hamster has been added, which has a map of the city, and sometimes he will be able to suggest the approximate location of objects!)

[b]Added:[/b]
- Help in the game every 3 minutes.
[b]Changed:[/b]
- Now you can choose any difficulty level right from the start of the game.
- In the description of the achievements, it is precisely indicated on which difficulty levels you can get the achievement.
[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Minor fixes with the location of objects.

notes.title: Game optimization update! :)
notes.notes:
Corrected:
- Now the game will not eat your computer's RAM.
- If you completed 7 levels before opening the last two, then when you enter the game you will receive achievements: Roses, Lizards, Cheese!)

I also want to say thanks to all the players who reported errors, thanks to you I was able to learn a lot of new things, and I can continue to please you with new games! )
